name: Rupak tala mridangam
desc: Carnatic-flavored mridangam cycle in rupak tala's seven beats (3+2+2): tin-tin-na / dhin-na / dhin-na theka voiced with ki, na and dhin strokes, ghost gumki underneath. Peak doubles into tirakita-style fills every other avartan. A true 7-beat groove, not 4/4 with decoration.

code.full: stack(s("mridangam_ki mridangam_ki mridangam_na mridangam_dhin mridangam_na mridangam_dhin mridangam_na").gain(${gain}*.85).shape(.3), s("mridangam_gumki(3,7,<0 2 4>)").gain(.22).pan(cosine.range(.4,.6).slow(8))).room(.15).fast(${rate}).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("mridangam_ki mridangam_ki mridangam_na mridangam_dhin mridangam_na mridangam_dhin mridangam_na").gain(${gain}*.9).shape(.35), s("<~ [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [mridangam_ta mridangam_ka] [mridangam_tha mridangam_ki]]>").gain(${gain}*.6), s("mridangam_gumki(5,7,<0 2 4 6>)").gain(.26).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(8))).room(.15).fast(${rate}).lastOf(2, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
